title.en: Apple announces Apple Intelligence at WWDC, bringing AI to over a billion devices
title.zhHans: Apple 在 WWDC 发布 Apple Intelligence，将 AI 带入超过十亿台设备

summary.en: On June 10, 2024, Apple announced Apple Intelligence at WWDC, marking the company's formal entry into the AI race. The personal intelligence system integrated generative AI models into iPhone, iPad, and Mac operating systems with a privacy-first architecture that processed most data on-device. Apple also announced a partnership with OpenAI to integrate ChatGPT into Siri and system-wide writing tools. The announcement signaled that AI had become a core platform feature, not a standalone product.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 6 月 10 日，Apple 在 WWDC 上宣布了 Apple Intelligence，标志着公司正式进入 AI 竞赛。这个个人智能系统将生成式 AI 模型集成到 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 操作系统中，采用注重隐私的架构，大部分数据在设备端处理。Apple 还宣布与 OpenAI 合作，将 ChatGPT 集成到 Siri 和系统级写作工具中。这一宣布标志着 AI 已成为核心平台功能，而非独立产品。

narrative.en: Apple had been conspicuously absent from the AI product race through 2023 and early 2024. While Microsoft, Google, Meta, and OpenAI shipped consumer AI products, Apple remained silent — leading to speculation that it was falling behind. WWDC 2024 answered decisively. Apple Intelligence was not a chatbot or a standalone app; it was a system-wide AI layer integrated into iOS 18, iPadOS 18, and macOS 15 Sequoia. The key features were: on-device and private cloud processing via Apple Silicon's Neural Engine; writing tools across Mail, Notes, and Pages; image generation (Image Playground); custom emoji (Genmoji); and a significantly smarter Siri with on-screen awareness and ChatGPT fallback. The privacy-first approach was Apple's key differentiator: instead of sending all data to cloud servers, Apple Intelligence could run entirely on-device for most tasks, with a Private Cloud Compute system for requests requiring more power — using Apple Silicon servers that did not store or expose user data. The ChatGPT integration was notable both for what it was (Apple partnering with a competitor) and what it said about the AI landscape (even Apple couldn't build everything in-house). Apple Intelligence rolled out in beta in fall 2024, with features arriving gradually through 2025.
narrative.zhHans: Apple 在 2023 年和 2024 年初一直引人注目地缺席 AI 产品竞赛。当 Microsoft、Google、Meta 和 OpenAI 纷纷推出消费 AI 产品时，Apple 保持沉默——导致人们猜测它正在落后。WWDC 2024 给出了决定性的答案。Apple Intelligence 不是一个聊天机器人或独立应用；它是一个系统级的 AI 层，集成到 iOS 18、iPadOS 18 和 macOS 15 Sequoia 中。关键功能包括：通过 Apple Silicon 神经引擎进行设备端和私有云处理；跨邮件、备忘录和 Pages 的写作工具；图像生成（Image Playground）；自定义表情符号（Genmoji）；以及具有屏幕感知能力和 ChatGPT 后备功能的显著更智能的 Siri。注重隐私的方法是 Apple 的关键差异化因素：Apple Intelligence 可以将大多数任务完全在设备端运行，对于需要更多算力的请求则使用不存储或暴露用户数据的 Apple Silicon 服务器组成的私有云计算系统。ChatGPT 集成之所以引人注目，既因为它本身（Apple 与竞争对手合作），也因为它揭示了 AI 格局的现状（即使 Apple 也无法完全自建一切）。Apple Intelligence 于 2024 年秋季开始 beta 测试，功能在 2025 年陆续推出。

description.en: Brought AI features to Apple's installed base of over 2 billion active devices. Made AI system-wide and integrated into the OS rather than requiring users to seek out standalone AI products. The privacy-first architecture set a new standard for consumer AI deployment.
description.zhHans: 将 AI 功能带入 Apple 超过 20 亿台活跃设备的用户基础。使 AI 成为系统级、集成到操作系统中的功能，而非需要用户主动寻找的独立 AI 产品。注重隐私的架构为消费级 AI 部署设立了新标准。

description.en: Signaled that AI was no longer a standalone product category but a core OS feature, following Apple's historical pattern of turning emerging technologies into mainstream platforms.
description.zhHans: 标志着 AI 不再是独立产品类别，而是核心操作系统功能——延续了 Apple 将新兴技术转变为主流平台的历史模式。

text.en: Apple announced Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024 on June 10, integrating generative AI models system-wide on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with a privacy-first architecture.
text.zhHans: Apple 于 2024 年 6 月 10 日在 WWDC 上宣布 Apple Intelligence，以注重隐私的架构将生成式 AI 模型系统级地集成到 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 中。

sources.quote: Introducing Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system that puts powerful generative models at the core of iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Apple announced 'Apple Intelligence' at WWDC 2024, its name for a new suite of AI features for the iPhone, Mac, and more.
